007_two_point_chowla.title: Ordinary two-point correlations and the corrected binary Elliott conjecture
007_two_point_chowla.official: The paper proves ordinary two-point Chowla and the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for complex multiplicative functions: if at least one of f1,f2 is uniformly non-pretentious, then (1/N) sum_{n<=N} f1(n+h1) f2(n+h2) -> 0 for every fixed pair of distinct shifts h1,h2. For the Liouville function it gives O(X/(log X)^c) for fixed nonproportional affine forms.

017_pi_irrationality.title: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
017_pi_irrationality.official: The paper proves mu(pi)=2: for every nu>2 there is Q(nu) such that |pi-p/q| >= q^{-nu} for all integers p and all q>=Q(nu). As a corollary the Flint-Hills series sum 1/(n^3 sin^2 n) converges.

087_mahler.title: The symmetric and general Mahler conjectures
087_mahler.official: The papers prove the symmetric and nonsymmetric geometric Mahler conjectures in every dimension. The minimizers are Hanner polytopes and simplices respectively, with equality classified; the sharp functional Mahler inequalities also hold, and every symmetric polar product has Gromov width 4.

102_basic_sdp.title: Basic-SDP threshold and Unique Games
102_basic_sdp.official: The family proves Khot's Unique Games Conjecture and derives optimal inapproximability thresholds (Max-Cut beyond Goemans-Williamson, Vertex Cover factor 2, Min-UnCut, directed FVS) by direct reductions. Therefore the BasicSDP threshold assertion in the prompt is affirmative (via UGC + Raghavendra or a direct reduction).

159_erdos_progressions.title: Erdos's reciprocal-sum conjecture and quasipolynomial Szemeredi bounds
159_erdos_progressions.official: The paper proves that every set of positive integers with divergent reciprocal sum contains arithmetic progressions of every finite length; moreover it proves a quantitative bound C_k N exp(-c_k (log N)^{eps_k}) for k-progression-free subsets of {1,...,N}.

197_kaplansky_direct_finiteness.title: A counterexample to Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture in positive characteristic
197_kaplansky_direct_finiteness.official: The paper disproves the unrestricted positive-characteristic direct-finiteness conjecture: it constructs a finitely presented torsion-free group (and a characteristic-two example) whose group algebra has ab=1 but ba != 1; it also constructs nonsofic groups and disproves Gottschalk's surjunctivity and the group-ring determinant conjecture.

221_mezard_parisi.title: The Mezard-Parisi formula for diluted spin glasses
221_mezard_parisi.official: Under the Panchenko-Talagrand factorization/positivity assumptions and first-moment integrability, the paper proves the thermodynamic limit exists and equals the infimum over finite replica-symmetry-breaking levels of the hierarchical trial functional; this covers Viana-Bray, symmetric diluted even-spin models and weighted soft even-K SAT.

271_heisenberg_magnetization.title: Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet
271_heisenberg_magnetization.official: The paper proves that for every d>=3 and every positive spin S, at every sufficiently low positive temperature there is a translation-invariant beta-KMS state with nonzero magnetization (at least S/4 in the Lean scope). The family also proves Bloch's T^{3/2} law with exact coefficient and the first lattice correction.

287_free_group_factors.title: Isomorphism of the free group factors
287_free_group_factors.official: The paper proves L(F_2) is isomorphic to L(F_3), hence all interpolated free group factors (including L(F_infinity)) are isomorphic; their common factor has fundamental group R_{>0}.

362_vlasov_maxwell.title: Global classical solutions of the 3D relativistic Vlasov-Maxwell system
362_vlasov_maxwell.official: The paper proves large-data global existence and uniqueness for the three-dimensional one-species relativistic Vlasov-Maxwell system: every smooth admissible datum (compact support, finite energy, bounded derivatives) has T_max = infinity and the solution is smooth on every finite time interval.
